mechanism_claims.claim_text: Peptide L1 directly damaged bacterial cell envelopes in SEM-treated V. parahaemolyticus and S. aureus samples; this supports a cell-envelope disruption mechanism for L1 under the tested lethal-dose conditions.
mechanism_claims.limitations: SEM was performed on two representative bacteria at 500 µg/mL; this supports cell-envelope damage but does not quantify membrane permeabilization kinetics or define a molecular binding target.
